AFOSI Kirtland record documents unexplained aerial objects over Coyote Canyon; Doty is associated with the Kirtland UFO file.
Shows Linda Moulton Howe a purported government briefing paper at Kirtland AFB, describing it as authoritative; she is not permitted to retain a copy.
MJ-12 film arrives anonymously at Jaime Shandera's address; Doty is later linked to the Moore-Shandera channel.

321-page New Mexico State Police personnel file released under state public-records law and published.

claims.source: Alejandro Rojas, HuffPost Weird News, 13 May 2014, https://www.huffpost.com/entry/exair-force-law-enforceme_b_5312650 , opened 2026-09-19
claims.text: THE ADMISSION SIDE, AND IT IS WEAKER THAN IT LOOKS. A dated named-outlet report states that Doty says he was tasked with hoaxing documents and feeding false information to UFO researchers while an AFOSI special agent at Kirtland, that he was ordered to make Paul Bennewitz believe in an impending alien invasion, and that he entered Bennewitz's house and office under orders. The piece paraphrases throughout and contains no direct quotation from him. It also records that the Air Force 'refuses to comment' and did not answer the author's letter.

claims.source: Inference from Alejandro Rojas, HuffPost, 13 May 2014 and Mystery Wire YouTube 9TLfM5VKX3M, both opened 2026-09-19
claims.text: STATED INFERENCE, AND IT BELONGS ON THIS NODE RATHER THAN IN A RATIONALE FIELD BECAUSE AN ENRICHMENT CANNOT CARRY ONE. Doty is on record both acknowledging a deception operation and denying its most damaging effect. A man who says he ran a disinformation operation is structurally difficult: his later statements cannot be used to establish anything he asserts, INCLUDING HIS DENIALS, and are evidence only of what he said and when. The board should not resolve the contradiction by preferring whichever quotation suits a narrative; it should carry both and grade neither above Tier 2. Reasoning: the reliability of a self-described deceiver is not recoverable from his own further statements.

label: Richard C. Doty
narrative: Doty is the only US counterintelligence officer to have stated on camera and on the record that he personally ran disinformation about UFOs against American civilians as part of his official duties. As an AFOSI special agent at Kirtland AFB from 1979, he authored or handled the 1980-1983 Kirtland documents concerning unexplained objects over Coyote Canyon, fed fabricated material to Paul Bennewitz, and in April 1983 showed the documentary producer Linda Moulton Howe a briefing paper purporting to describe a government programme - the 'Project Aquarius' teletype - which she was not permitted to copy. He was also a conduit in the emergence of the MJ-12 material through Bill Moore. He left AFOSI in 1988 and later served as a New Mexico State Police officer; his 321-page state police personnel file was obtained under the New Mexico Inspection of Public Records Act and published in 2021, giving the first full documentary picture of his post-Air Force career. Doty's value to this board is not that his statements are reliable - they are not, and he has repeatedly changed them - but that his existence is the proof of concept. The United States assigned a counterintelligence officer to manage the UFO information environment. He has said so. Whatever else is in dispute, that is not.
